stem_book: A 10 kg block is placed on an inclined plane with an inclination of 45°. The coefficient of friction between the block and the plane is 0.3. What is the minimum force parallel to the plane required to keep the block at rest? (Take g = 10 m/s²) (a) 50 N (b) 60 N (c) 80 N (d) 100 N
reason: g = 10 m/s² added (unstated in print); exact value 49.5 N ≈ 50 N
